method: Same-page native construction and physical cap-height comparison; thresholds165/185/205. Uniform cap scaling only; no width fit.
size_assignment: Native construction and physical cap heights match the labelled same-page samples: name12point, role8point, other four rows6point. Unlabelled card composition is distinguished from the printed size headings.
limitations: Small card text is faint and does not improve the retained capital sources. Source contours were not filled, widened independently or redrawn.

selected.reason: Thresholds175–195 lose the faint descending tail;205 retains its length but flattens its left curve. Threshold215 retains the observed head, left indentation and complete tail;225 adds soft fringe.
selected.period_comparison: The two card periods do not improve the clearer document-period source, which remains exact.
